meta.name: entra-agent-id
meta.description: Provision Microsoft Entra Agent Identity Blueprints, BlueprintPrincipals, and per-instance Agent Identities via Microsoft Graph, and configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant) including the Microsoft Entra SDK for AgentID sidecar. USE FOR: Agent Identity Blueprint, BlueprintPrincipal, agent OAuth, fmi_path token exchange, agent OBO, Workload Identity Federation for agents, polyglot agent auth, Microsoft.Identity.Web.AgentIdentities. DO NOT USE FOR: standard Entra app registration (use entra-app-registration), Microsoft Foundry agent authoring (use microsoft-foundry).

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为AI代理配置Microsoft Entra身份蓝图与OAuth令牌交换
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在Microsoft Entra中为AI代理管理身份和OAuth流程
copy.tagline_en: Provision Microsoft Entra agent identity blueprints and configure OAuth token exchange
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to manage agent identities and OAuth flows in Microsoft Entra

howto.what: 这个技能让Claude能通过Microsoft Graph为AI代理创建和管理独立的OAuth 2.0身份。每个代理实例获得唯一的身份、审计跟踪和独立权限。
howto.when: 当你需要为AI代理配置身份蓝图、创建代理实例身份、或设置OAuth 2.0令牌交换（如fmi_path、OBO、跨租户）时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个名为“客服代理”的Agent Identity Blueprint。
say.note: Claude会调用Graph API创建蓝图应用对象。

say.text: 为我的代理实例“agent-1”创建一个Agent Identity。
say.note: Claude会创建服务主体并分配赞助人。

say.text: 给代理身份“agent-1”授予User.Read.All应用权限。

howto.what_en: This skill enables Claude to create and manage distinct OAuth 2.0 identities for AI agents via Microsoft Graph. Each agent instance gets a unique identity, audit trail, and independently-scoped permissions.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you need to provision Agent Identity Blueprints, create per-instance Agent Identities, or configure OAuth 2.0 token exchange (fmi_path, OBO, cross-tenant).

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity Blueprint named 'Customer Service Agent'.
say_en.note: Claude will call Graph API to create the blueprint application.

say_en.text: Create an Agent Identity for my agent instance 'agent-1'.
say_en.note: Claude will create a service principal and assign a sponsor.

say_en.text: Grant User.Read.All application permission to agent identity 'agent-1'.
